arguments.query:
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS rid, p.card_scheme, p.is_credit, p.aci, p.eur_amount, p.has_fraudulent_dispute,
    IF(p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country, 1, 0) AS intra_flag,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE(p.year,1,1), INTERVAL p.day_of_year-1 DAY)) AS m
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
  WHERE p.merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND p.year = 2023
),
mon AS (
  SELECT m, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol, SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) AS fr
  FROM tx GROUP BY m
),
mon_b AS (
  SELECT m,
    CASE WHEN vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN vol <= 1000000 THEN '100k-1m' WHEN vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_b,
    CASE WHEN fr < 0.072 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN fr <= 0.077 THEN '7.2%-7.7%' WHEN fr <= 0.083 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fr_b
  FROM mon
),
fee_rules AS (
  SELECT * FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` WHERE 8062 IN UNNEST(merchant_category_code)
),
matches AS (
  SELECT t.rid, t.eur_amount, f.ID, f.fixed_amount, f.rate
  FROM tx t
  JOIN mon_b b ON t.m = b.m
  JOIN fee_rules f ON f.card_scheme = t.card_scheme
  WHERE (ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type) = 0 OR 'F' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
    AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = '<3')
    AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = b.fr_b)
    AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = b.vol_b)
    AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)
    AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci) = 0 OR t.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
    AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = t.intra_flag)
),
per_tx AS (
  SELECT t.rid, COUNT(m.ID) AS n_rules, AVG(m.fixed_amount + m.rate * t.eur_amount / 10000) AS fee_avg, MIN(m.fixed_amount + m.rate * t.eur_amount / 10000) AS fee_min, MAX(m.fixed_amount + m.rate * t.eur_amount / 10000) AS fee_max
  FROM tx t LEFT JOIN matches m ON m.rid = t.rid
  GROUP BY t.rid
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tx,
  COUNTIF(n_rules = 0) AS no_match,
  COUNTIF(n_rules = 1) AS one_match,
  COUNTIF(n_rules > 1) AS multi_match,
  SUM(fee_min) AS fee_sum_min,
  SUM(fee_max) AS fee_sum_max,
  SUM(fee_avg) AS fee_sum_avg
FROM per_tx

mon AS (

),
mon_b AS (
  SELECT m,
    CASE WHEN vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN vol <= 1000000 THEN '100k-1m' WHEN vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_b,

base AS (

arguments.query:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT merchant, account_type,
    CASE
      WHEN capture_delay IN ('manual','immediate') THEN capture_delay
      WHEN SAFE_CAST(capture_delay AS INT64) < 3 THEN '<3'
      WHEN SAFE_CAST(capture_delay AS INT64) <= 5 THEN '3-5'
      WHEN SAFE_CAST(capture_delay AS INT64) > 5 THEN '>5'
    END AS cd
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.merchant_data`
  WHERE merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso'
),
t AS (
  SELECT p.psp_reference, p.merchant, p.card_scheme, p.is_credit, p.eur_amount, p.aci,
    CAST(p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country AS INT64) AS intra,
    p.has_fraudulent_dispute,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE_ADD(DATE(p.year,1,1), INTERVAL p.day_of_year - 1 DAY), MONTH) AS month
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
  JOIN m ON p.merchant = m.merchant
  WHERE p.year = 2023
),
mon AS (
  SELECT month, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol,
    SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) AS fr
  FROM t GROUP BY month
),
tb AS (
  SELECT t.*, m.account_type, m.cd, mon.vol, mon.fr,
    CASE WHEN mon.vol < 100000 THEN '<100k'
         WHEN mon.vol <= 1000000 THEN '100k-1m'
         WHEN mon.vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m'
         ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_band,
    CASE WHEN mon.fr < 0.072 THEN '<7.2%'
         WHEN mon.fr <= 0.077 THEN '7.2%-7.7%'
         WHEN mon.fr <= 0.083 THEN '7.7%-8.3%'
         ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fr_band
  FROM t
  JOIN mon ON t.month = mon.month
  CROSS JOIN m
),
sel AS (
  SELECT mcc, tb.* FROM tb CROSS JOIN UNNEST([7993, 8062]) AS mcc
),
per_tx AS (
  SELECT s.mcc, s.psp_reference, s.eur_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(r.fixed_amount, 0) + COALESCE(r.rate, 0) * s.eur_amount / 10000) AS fee
  FROM sel s
  LEFT JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` r
    ON (r.card_scheme IS NULL OR r.card_scheme = s.card_scheme)
    AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(r.account_type) = 0 OR s.account_type IN UNNEST(r.account_type))
    AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(r.merchant_category_code) = 0 OR s.mcc IN UNNEST(r.merchant_category_code))
    AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(r.aci) = 0 OR s.aci IN UNNEST(r.aci))
    AND (r.is_credit IS NULL OR r.is_credit = s.is_credit)
    AND (r.intracountry IS NULL OR r.intracountry = s.intra)
    AND (r.capture_delay IS NULL OR r.capture_delay = s.cd)
    AND (r.monthly_volume IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume = s.vol_band)
    AND (r.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR r.monthly_fraud_level = s.fr_band)
  GROUP BY s.mcc, s.psp_reference, s.eur_amount
),
tot AS (
  SELECT mcc, SUM(fee) AS total_fee, COUNT(*) AS n_tx FROM per_tx GROUP BY mcc
)
SELECT
  (SELECT total_fee FROM tot WHERE mcc = 8062) - (SELECT total_fee FROM tot WHERE mcc = 7993) AS delta,
  (SELECT total_fee FROM tot WHERE mcc = 7993) AS fee_current_mcc_7993,
  (SELECT total_fee FROM tot WHERE mcc = 8062) AS fee_new_mcc_8062,
  (SELECT n_tx FROM tot WHERE mcc = 7993) AS n_transactions
